question: What file dependencies does the recovered start-up path have?
answer: One: Direct3D11.dll. The plugin loader resolves it with LoadLibraryA, takes exports with GetProcAddress and releases it with FreeLibrary on failure.
where_the_name_comes_from: GraphicsEngineSettings, whose leading std::string defaults to "direct3d11" (length 0x0A). The loader is what turns that name into the module.
implication_for_a_host: A host that runs from the game directory, or that makes it the DLL search path, satisfies the only file dependency. No game data files are needed for GraphicsEngine::Initialize, whose six rounds are pure in-memory manager construction.
not_established: whether the Direct3D11 device needs shader bytecode that the plugin embeds or fetches
whether later Engine::Initialize subsystems open data files
the meaning of the four strings and five booleans
method_note: The earlier attempt to resolve these IAT slots returned unknown because I used full virtual addresses instead of RVAs; subtracting the image base gave the correct entries.
